source.title: Albanian ladder, a2-1: Një ditë në Durrës (machine-drafted)
source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)

source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model against the ladder gate (coverage and new words measured by npm run ladder:check) and the word-form checks of npm run sq:check-texts. Not reviewed by a native speaker: it may contain unnatural or incorrect Albanian. The English lines are the drafter's own.

review.notes: Machine-drafted ladder unit (adapter-sq@8); awaiting a named native reviewer (npm run review:packet). Day trip to Durrës. Facts to check: Durrës is the second city of the republic; there is a train from Tirana to Durrës (check that it is a real, running service; the story only says "treni"); a bigger island near Vlorë (Sazan); a sea trip on a small ship. Everything else is invented.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Të shtunën në verë Sami, Luani, Ana, Ardi dhe Elira shkuan në Durrës.
sentences.english: On a Saturday in summer Sam, Luan, Ana, Ardi and Elira went to Durrës.

sentences.text: Ishte dita e parë e pushimit të tyre.
sentences.english: It was the first day of their holiday.

sentences.text: Ata u nisën herët nga stacioni i Tiranës.
sentences.english: They set off early from the station of Tirana.

sentences.text: Në stacion kishte një tabelë të madhe me shkronja të kuqe: «DURRËS».
sentences.english: At the station there was a big sign with red letters: "DURRËS".

sentences.text: — Ja treni ynë! — tha Ardi me zë të madh dhe vrapoi te dera.
sentences.english: "There is our train!" said Ardi in a loud voice and ran to the door.

sentences.text: Treni kishte shumë njerëz që shkonin në plazh.
sentences.english: The train had many people who were going to the beach.

sentences.text: Në tren Luani lexonte gazetën, dhe Ana lexonte një revistë.
sentences.english: On the train Luan was reading the newspaper, and Ana was reading a magazine.

sentences.text: — Ka një lajm të bukur për bregdetin — tha Luani.
sentences.english: "There is nice news about the coast," said Luan.

sentences.text: — Këtë verë hoteli i ri hapet pranë plazhit.
sentences.english: "This summer the new hotel opens near the beach."

sentences.text: Sami nuk lexonte gazetë: ai kishte një roman në çantë.
sentences.english: Sam was not reading a newspaper: he had a novel in his bag.

sentences.text: — Një shkrimtar i njohur ka shkruar një tregim për detin — tha ai.
sentences.english: "A well-known writer has written a story about the sea," he said.

sentences.text: — Ka edhe një poezi në fund të librit.
sentences.english: "There is also a poem at the end of the book."

sentences.text: Pranë tyre ishte një grup nga një shkollë, dhe çdo anëtar i grupit këndonte.
sentences.english: Next to them was a group from a school, and every member of the group was singing.

sentences.text: — Ende nuk e di ku është plazhi — tha Elira.
sentences.english: "I do not know yet where the beach is," said Elira.

sentences.text: — Akoma një orë — tha Ana.
sentences.english: "Another hour," said Ana.

sentences.text: Ardi dhe Elira mblidhnin gurë të vegjël që kishin sjellë nga shtëpia.
sentences.english: Ardi and Elira were collecting little stones that they had brought from home.

sentences.text: Ata luanin dhe buzëqeshnin gjithë rrugën.
sentences.english: They played and smiled all the way.

sentences.text: Kur arritën në Durrës, dielli ishte i lartë.
sentences.english: When they arrived in Durrës, the sun was high.

sentences.text: Durrësi është një qytet i madh në bregdet, dhe popullsia e tij rritet në verë.
sentences.english: Durrës is a big city on the coast, and its population grows in summer.

sentences.text: Është qyteti i dytë i republikës.
sentences.english: It is the second city of the republic.

sentences.text: Ata ecën në një bulevard të gjerë, pranë detit.
sentences.english: They walked along a wide boulevard, near the sea.

sentences.text: Ardi tregoi një tabelë tjetër me shkronja të bardha: «Bregdeti i Durrësit».
sentences.english: Ardi pointed to another sign with white letters: "The coast of Durrës".

sentences.text: Nga larg panë një muze të vjetër dhe një shesh të njohur me shumë njerëz.
sentences.english: From far away they saw an old museum and a well-known square with many people.

sentences.text: — Ky qytet ka një histori shumë të gjatë — tha Luani. — Unë studioj historinë e tij në libra të vjetër.
sentences.english: "This city has a very long history," said Luan. "I study its history in old books."

sentences.text: — Treni vjen nga kryeqyteti çdo orë, dhe muzeu është një muze kombëtar — shtoi ai.
sentences.english: "The train comes from the capital every hour, and the museum is a national museum," he added.

sentences.text: — Atë historik e lexova në një tekst.
sentences.english: "I read that history in a text."

sentences.text: — Do ta shohim muzeun nesër — tha Ana. — Sot është dita e detit.
sentences.english: "We will see the museum tomorrow," said Ana. "Today is the day of the sea."

sentences.text: Në plazh nuk kishte tepër njerëz.
sentences.english: On the beach there were not too many people.

sentences.text: Rëra ishte e ngrohtë dhe uji ishte i bukur dhe i ftohtë.
sentences.english: The sand was warm and the water was beautiful and cold.

sentences.text: Ardi dhe Elira vrapuan në det dhe notuan shumë.
sentences.english: Ardi and Elira ran into the sea and swam a lot.

sentences.text: Sami notoi pak, pastaj u ul në rërë dhe lexoi tregimin.
sentences.english: Sam swam a little, then sat on the sand and read the story.

sentences.text: Ana e shikonte detin dhe mendoi për punën e saj.
sentences.english: Ana looked at the sea and thought of her work.

sentences.text: — Si infermiere kam një këshillë — tha ajo.
sentences.english: "As a nurse I have a piece of advice," she said.

sentences.text: — Mos rrini shumë në diell, sepse trupi ka nevojë për hije.
sentences.english: "Do not stay long in the sun, because the body needs shade."

sentences.text: — Në farmaci ka ilaçe për diellin, por këshilla më e mirë është hija.
sentences.english: "In the pharmacy there are medicines for the sun, but the best advice is shade."

sentences.text: Elira u kthye me një gjë të vogël në këmbë.
sentences.english: Elira came back with a little something on her foot.

sentences.text: — Ana, kam gjak! — tha ajo me zë të lartë.
sentences.english: "Ana, I have blood!" she said in a loud voice.

sentences.text: Ana e kontrolloi dhe buzëqeshi: — Është vetëm një gur i vogël. Nuk është e thyer asnjë kockë.
sentences.english: Ana examined it and smiled: "It is only a little stone. No bone is broken."

sentences.text: Elira nuk qau më.
sentences.english: Elira did not cry any more.

sentences.text: Elira i tha Samit: — Në shkencë mësuam për detin. A mund të më ndihmosh të shkruaj një fjali për të?
sentences.english: Elira said to Sam: "In science we learned about the sea. Can you help me write a sentence about it?"

sentences.text: — Po — tha Sami. — Unë mësoj shqip çdo ditë, dhe shkrimi më pëlqen shumë.
sentences.english: "Yes," said Sam. "I learn Albanian every day, and I like writing a lot."

sentences.text: Ai e ndihmoi dhe Elira shkroi: «Deti është i madh dhe i bukur.»
sentences.english: He helped her and Elira wrote: "The sea is big and beautiful."

sentences.text: Pranë tyre ishte një infermier nga Shkodra, që po pushonte me familjen.
sentences.english: Near them was a nurse from Shkodër, who was on holiday with his family.

sentences.text: Ai i tha Anës: — Keni mirë: pushimi është një ilaç i mirë.
sentences.english: He said to Ana: "You are right: a holiday is a good medicine."

sentences.text: Ata folën pak për punën, pastaj për detin.
sentences.english: They talked a little about work, then about the sea.

sentences.text: Në drekë u ulën në një restorant pranë plazhit.
sentences.english: At lunch they sat down in a restaurant near the beach.

sentences.text: Kamarieri u shërbeu peshk, sallatë dhe bukë.
sentences.english: The waiter served them fish, salad and bread.

sentences.text: Luani porositi një supë, sepse nuk i pëlqente peshku.
sentences.english: Luan ordered a soup, because he did not like fish.

sentences.text: Ardi ngriti dorën dhe tha: — Pastaj duam akullore!
sentences.english: Ardi raised his hand and said: "Then we want ice cream!"

sentences.text: Të gjithë buzëqeshën.
sentences.english: Everyone smiled.

sentences.text: Pas drekës ata ecën në një rrugë të gjatë pranë bregdetit dhe hëngrën akullore.
sentences.english: After lunch they walked along a long road near the coast and ate ice cream.

sentences.text: Elira zgjodhi një akullore me çokollatë, dhe Ardi një me mollë.
sentences.english: Elira chose a chocolate ice cream, and Ardi one with apple.

sentences.text: Pastaj ata ecën në bulevard dhe shikuan hotelet e mëdha.
sentences.english: Then they walked on the boulevard and looked at the big hotels.

sentences.text: Në një shesh të vogël një burrë shiste lule dhe tregime për fëmijë.
sentences.english: In a small square a man was selling flowers and stories for children.

sentences.text: Ardi pyeti: — A ka ishull këtu në det?
sentences.english: Ardi asked: "Is there an island here in the sea?"

sentences.text: — Jo shumë afër — tha Ana. — Por me anije mund të shohim bregdetin nga larg.
sentences.english: "Not very close," said Ana. "But by ship we can see the coast from far away."

sentences.text: Sami bëri disa fotografi për bashkësinë e tij.
sentences.english: Sam took some photographs for his congregation.

sentences.text: Atij i pëlqente çdo gjë: uji, rëra, njerëzit dhe dielli.
sentences.english: He liked everything: the water, the sand, the people and the sun.

sentences.text: — Këtu çdo njeri është më i lumtur — tha ai.
sentences.english: "Here everyone is happier," he said.

sentences.text: — Pushimi bën mirë — u përgjigj Luani. — Njeriu ka nevojë për pak kohë.
sentences.english: "A holiday does good," answered Luan. "A person needs a little time."

sentences.text: Pasdite Luani gjeti një njoftim: një anije e vogël shkonte në det për një orë.
sentences.english: In the afternoon Luan found an announcement: a small ship was going out to sea for an hour.

sentences.text: Ata blenë bileta dhe u ngjitën në anije.
sentences.english: They bought tickets and climbed onto the ship.

sentences.text: Ishte një anije e bardhë dhe e vjetër, por e bukur.
sentences.english: It was a white, old ship, but beautiful.

sentences.text: Pas pak një varkë e vogël kaloi pranë tyre, dhe një burrë në varkë buzëqeshi.
sentences.english: After a little while a small boat passed beside them, and a man in the boat smiled.

sentences.text: — Ku shkon kjo varkë? — pyeti Elira.
sentences.english: "Where is this boat going?" asked Elira.

sentences.text: — Shkon në një ishull të vogël — tha një grua.
sentences.english: "It goes to a small island," said a woman.

sentences.text: — Në Vlorë, pranë detit, ka një ishull më të madh — shtoi Luani.
sentences.english: "In Vlorë, by the sea, there is a bigger island," added Luan.

sentences.text: Sami shikoi bregdetin që mbetej larg.
sentences.english: Sam looked at the coast that stayed far away.

sentences.text: Detin e pa për herë të parë në këtë vend, dhe i pëlqeu shumë.
sentences.english: He saw the sea for the first time in this country, and he liked it very much.

sentences.text: Ai mendoi për poezinë që kishte lexuar.
sentences.english: He thought about the poem he had read.

sentences.text: Në mbrëmje ata u kthyen në stacion.
sentences.english: In the evening they went back to the station.

sentences.text: Ishin të lodhur, por të lumtur.
sentences.english: They were tired, but happy.

sentences.text: Ardi fjeti në tren me një gur të vogël në dorë.
sentences.english: Ardi fell asleep on the train with a small stone in his hand.

sentences.text: Elira i tha Anës: — Ky ishte pushimi më i mirë.
sentences.english: Elira said to Ana: "This was the best holiday."

sentences.text: — Do të vijmë edhe një herë vitin tjetër — tha Ana.
sentences.english: "We will come once more next year," said Ana.
